decisions.reason: As a recent line extension in the firm’s core drainage range, the black-finish variant benefits from sunk design and production effort and management is likely to give it more time, even if uptake is still modest.

This shower channel was given its own page, is close to the established offer, and fits the firm’s public direction toward modern bathroom architecture, so management is very likely to continue backing it.

Although the pump-assisted solution is somewhat more specialized and may face slower market acceptance, it still builds on the core drainage business and escalation of commitment makes an early withdrawal unlikely.
The tileable floor drain is a highly adjacent product with visible website commitment and clear relevance to barrier-free, design-led bathrooms, so the firm would be inclined to persist with it.

The stainless steel design grate matches the company’s design-and-engineering positioning and public product presentation, making management likely to retain it and treat any weak early results as temporary.
